theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ρ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ρ j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (ρ j)) ∧ (∀ j y, 0 ≤ ρ j y) ∧ (∀ j, ∫ y, ρ j y = 1) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (ρ j) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) (r / ((j : ℝ) + 1))) ∧ ∀ G : Set (Rn N), NullMeasurableSet G volume → (∀ j, ∃ L : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith L (fun y ↦ ∫ z in G, ρ j (y - z))) ∧ (∀ j y, 0 ≤ (∫ z in G, ρ j (y - z)) ∧ (∫ z in G, ρ j (y - z)) ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ z in G, ρ j (y - z)) atTop (𝓝 (G.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) y))) ∧ ∀ h : Rn N → ℝ, Integrable h → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ y, (∫ z in G, ρ j (y - z)) * h y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in G, h y))
